scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,gateway,desktop -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:core" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:core: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-dotnet-env.ps1 run --project TinadecCore/Api/TinadecCore.Api.csproj --urls http://127.0.0.1:48731
scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && cd TinadecGateway && bun run build && cd .. && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-dotnet-env.ps1 build TinadecOffice.slnx --no-restore
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && cd TinadecGateway && bun test && cd .. && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-dotnet-env.ps1 test TinadecOffice.slnx --no-build
scripts.restore:dotnet: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-dotnet-env.ps1 restore TinadecCore/TinadecCore.slnx && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-dotnet-env.ps1 restore TinadecOffice.slnx
scripts.ai:tools:install: npm i -g @colbymchenry/codegraph && codegraph telemetry off && codegraph install --target=opencode --location=local --yes
